name: 7Seas Entertainment Ltd.
summary: 7Seas Entertainment Ltd. primarily focuses on the creation of digital gaming software. The company delivers a variety of interactive entertainment experiences, including games accessible online, on mobile devices, and personal computers, as well as applications specifically designed for Facebook. In addition to game development, the firm manages and operates several online gaming platforms, notably onlinerealgames.com, 7seasmedia.com, neodelight.com, and mobizill.com. Established on August 14, 1991, its corporate headquarters are situated in Hyderabad, India.
